name: Rowlet
description: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

moves.name: Gust
moves.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Leafage
moves.description: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Magical Leaf
moves.description: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky.

moves.name: Leaf Blade
moves.description: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by cutting its target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Leaf Storm
moves.description: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The recoil from this move lowers the user’s offensive stats.
